summary: Backend engineer with 6 years building payment and logistics services in Go and Python, certified in AWS and Kubernetes. Cut payments API p99 latency from 900 ms to 220 ms and built a Kafka pipeline that reconciles 2M payment events a day.

bullets.text: Built a Go settlement reconciliation service that processes 2M payment events a day from Kafka into PostgreSQL.
Cut payments API p99 latency from 900 ms to 220 ms with Redis caching and new PostgreSQL indexes.
Migrated 14 services from EC2 to Kubernetes on AWS EKS using Terraform and Helm.
Ran incident reviews and wrote the on-call runbook for an 8-engineer payments team.
Designed RESTful APIs in Python and FastAPI for shipment tracking, used by 120 enterprise customers.
Replaced nightly batch jobs with an event pipeline on AWS SQS and Lambda, taking data freshness from 24 hours to 5 minutes.
Built an offline-first sync workflow for the driver app backend in TypeScript and Node.js.
Automated CSV ingestion with Python scripts, saving the analytics team about 6 hours a week.
Maintained React and JavaScript dashboards for client reporting.
Wrote ledgerlite, an open-source double-entry ledger library in Go with 1.2k GitHub stars.
